RimMandrake.Wreckage.RM_WreckDensityClas.label: riddled
RimMandrake.Wreckage.RM_WreckDensityClas.description: Deep nightside: nobody goes, and the cold stops corrosion. The densest wreck fields on the planet.

RimMandrake.Wreckage.RM_WreckDensityClas.label: high
RimMandrake.Wreckage.RM_WreckDensityClas.description: Sea floors: only a gravship gets down, so almost no one can or would bother to go there.

RimMandrake.Wreckage.RM_WreckDensityClas.label: moderate
RimMandrake.Wreckage.RM_WreckDensityClas.description: Hostile land: lethal terrain, heat, radiation or rot, and few visitors.

RimMandrake.Wreckage.RM_WreckDensityClas.label: low
RimMandrake.Wreckage.RM_WreckDensityClas.description: Hostile but crossed, or land that buries and reveals.

RimMandrake.Wreckage.RM_WreckDensityClas.label: eroded
RimMandrake.Wreckage.RM_WreckDensityClas.description: Wrecks are present, but the biome eats them and little remains: fragments only.
